summary.text: Paul Flynn is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 63 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists his profession as pastor, real estate agent and entrepreneur.

paragraphs.text: Paul Flynn assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 3, 2024, succeeding Scott Cyrway.
Ballotpedia describes his career experience as serving as a pastor, working as a real estate agent, and being an entrepreneur.
He advanced from the June 9, 2026 Republican primary.
